method: Playwright headless Chromium on live pages; inputs typed into on-page fields; outputs scraped from rendered DOM. Analytics beacons blocked.
format_notes: expected values are the exact live display strings. Keys: 'headline:<label>' = big result number; 'li:<label>' = pipeline row; 'text:<id>' = string that must appear in the result panel; other keys = stat label. Visual explore sliders left at their defaults (see formulas.md). The source shows an em-dash character for non-finite results (division by zero); a DOE build may assert a DOE-styled placeholder instead. Rounding: money/count follow Intl.NumberFormat (shortest-decimal, half away from zero), percent/ratio follow Number.toFixed (exact binary); verify/ref.py reproduces all vectors.
